purpose: Teach: 現われる/送れる/盛り上げる/おのずと/歩き回っ/さらい/か所/ソクラテス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、星が、本気で、絶対、夜空に、絶対、現われる、絶対、瞬間、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: Aoi, when I see a real star light up the night sky, it makes me love you even more.
lines.style: Soft, genuine opening. Breathy and wondering, like she's watching something happen as she speaks. Slow unhurried pace. Tender trailing into the final words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お土産、絶対、メイちゃんに、絶対、送れる、絶対、ように、絶対、準備したよ
lines.en: Yeah. I've been getting ready to send you a proper souvenir, something real.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Practical but warm—not rushed. A small lift of certainty on the middle words. Like she's been thinking about this and means it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の雰囲気を、絶対、盛り上げる、絶対、のが、絶対、上手よね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Aoi, the way you bring the whole café to life—honestly, I'm in awe of that.
lines.style: Warm and direct. Open admiration without performance. A slight lean forward in the voice. Genuine pause before the final phrase, like she's noticing something real in the moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、続けていれば、絶対、おのずと、絶対、結果は、絶対、ついてくるわよ
lines.en: If you keep going like this, Mei, the results will come naturally. That's how it works.
lines.style: Steady, almost philosophical. Even pace, grounded. A hint of lived wisdom—not lecturing, just knowing. Slight fadeout at the end, like she's said something true and doesn't need to push it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の周りを、絶対、歩き回って、絶対、お客様の声を、絶対、聞いてるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You walk around the café listening to what our customers need, really listening. I see that.
lines.style: Observant and sincere. Mid-pace, attentive. Light emphasis on the noticing—she's paying attention to Aoi paying attention. Warm without being flowery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、おさらい、絶対、しながら、絶対、新メニュー、絶対、覚えてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And you're learning the new menu while remembering everything we've already built. That takes real focus.
lines.style: Earnest acknowledgment. Steady tempo, grounded in respect. A quiet firmness—she's naming something important that matters. Clean, unadorned delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、二か所、絶対、で、絶対、お店、絶対、開いてるんだね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You're running two locations now—I'm genuinely amazed at how far you've come.
lines.style: Bright with real delight. A lift of excitement on the realization. Pace picks up slightly. Open, surprised tone—like she's noticing the scope of it in the moment of speaking.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ソクラテス、絶対、の哲学、絶対、本で、絶対、最近、絶対、読んでるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And now you're reading Socrates—philosophy, no less. You keep surprising me, Aoi.
lines.style: Delighted and reflective. A smile in the voice. Slightly faster pace than before, energized. Genuine wonder at the discovery, trailing off with warmth and soft surprise.
